shots.prompt: Light professional retouch of this real fashion e-commerce photo, like a high-end retoucher would do. Keep the SAME real woman and her identity. Refine subtly: balance eye symmetry (both eyes equally open, same size and level, irises centered, gaze direct), even and harmonious facial features, without changing her face shape or who she is. Calm, confident, relaxed fashion-model expression, lips softly closed. Relax the shoulders and hands very slightly; same pose, framing and camera angle. Change the top garment (product 125-7071) to Sky blue.  Replace any footwear with closed-toe white leather ballet flats: round toe, completely flat sole, no heel, no straps, toes fully covered. Both feet fully visible and correctly proportioned. Never sandals, heels, or open toes. Keep every garment's exact cut, fabric weave, seams, stitching and buttons. MAKEUP: remove any dark or smoky eye makeup completely: no dark eyeshadow, no black eyeliner, no smudged liner under the eyes, no dark circles. Clean 'no-makeup' fashion-model look: bare-looking soft eyelids in a light neutral tone, a touch of soft brown mascara, natural groomed brows, fresh nude-pink lips, light natural blush. No shine, no highlighter, no contouring. SKIN: smoother, even, luminous but matte, softened under-eye area, fine natural skin texture kept (no plastic, no blur). Hair neat and glossy. Pure white background, same soft studio light. Looks like a real photo from a premium brand catalog (COS, Massimo Dutti), indistinguishable from an untouched real photograph.
